shortDescription: Drafts Australian NDAs, subscription terms, privacy policies and services agreements for lawyer review.
longDescription: Configures controlled drafting profiles, prepares first-draft Australian commercial documents and reviews drafts against an issues checklist. Preserves non-excludable rights, flags unfair terms, separates future privacy amendments and routes specialist privacy and employment questions. Every draft requires a qualified lawyer to review it.
defaultPrompt: Create a controlled drafting profile for this Australian business.
Draft a mutual or one-way Australian NDA for lawyer review.
Draft Australian SaaS subscription terms preserving consumer rights.
Draft a privacy policy from the verified data-handling inventory.
Draft a B2B services agreement and statement of work for lawyer review.
Review this commercial draft and return a prioritised issues table.
whatItDoes: Configures drafting-party details and standard positions
Drafts NDAs, website terms, privacy policies and services agreements
Checks drafting gaps, cross-references and unfair-terms risk
Records instructions, source evidence and unresolved decisions
boundaries: First drafts only; qualified lawyer review required
Never publishes, sends, signs or certifies enforceability
Never imports licensed precedent text into the public clause bank

requires.australian-legal-research: Verifies Commonwealth and state legislation at the relevant drafting date.

handsOffTo.australian-privacy-cybersecurity: Assesses privacy coverage, APP obligations and automated-decision transparency.
handsOffTo.australian-employment-fair-work: Assesses worker classification and sham-contracting concerns before contractor wording is settled.
